answer: Sealed-bid orchard auction stops bulk forgery: each applicant locks 70 and files one key-sealed bid for a garden plot. Bids open after the close; top 100 win. Each winner files a timber harvest log per epoch; an auditor rechecks yield on the public timber table within 3%; a mismatch or reused plot burns the bond. First 40, k-th 40+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 and lock 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. Rented plots fail; honest pays 40 once.
